outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Trademarks page
outreach_draft.body:
Adrian,

I was looking through Spearman Legal’s site and noticed Bankruptcy, Bankruptcy Creditor Services, and Trademarks are all presented through the same general Practice Areas experience rather than having focused client pages of their own.

Those are very different conversations. A business owner trying to protect a brand or trademark is arriving with different questions and priorities from an individual considering bankruptcy or a creditor dealing with a bankruptcy matter.

A dedicated Trademarks page could speak directly to that person, give Google a focused page to crawl and index, and give AI tools clearer context around that part of your practice.

I’m using Trademarks as the first mockup because the contrast with the bankruptcy work makes the idea easy to see while keeping the firm’s current positioning intact.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
